name: pets

variables.name: searchQuery
variables.description: Two-way search model; the core input debounces its change callback by 250 ms. Callbacks read the current model so delayed callbacks cannot resurrect cleared text.

variables.name: status
variables.description: Two-way server-selected status; explicit Dropdown callback assigns its value before syncStatus. Defaults to available.

variables.name: category
variables.description: Two-way client category selection; explicit Dropdown callback assigns its value before local filtering. The all-categories sentinel cannot collide with prefixed category values.

variables.name: sortOrder
variables.description: Two-way Name A–Z or Z–A selection; explicit Dropdown callback assigns its value before local sorting on a new page-local array.

variables.name: categoryOptions
variables.description: Dropdown items derived from the full successful normalized list, never from filtered/paginated results.

variables.name: allPets
variables.description: Page-local shallow copy of the latest accepted normalized list. Never sorted or mutated in the shared service.

variables.name: searchIndex
variables.description: Lowercase search text cached once per returned pet, containing name, category, original string ID, and every tag.

variables.name: filteredPets
variables.description: Computed filtered, sorted snapshot; never recalculated from a view expression.

variables.name: visiblePets
variables.description: At most 12 pets sliced for the current client page.

variables.name: currentPage
variables.description: One-based two-way core Pagination model. Its verified onPageChange(currentPage) callback explicitly assigns the selected page before slicing; filter/load changes reset it.

variables.name: pageSize
variables.description: Fixed client page size.

variables.name: isLoading
variables.description: Local active-request state; stale requests cannot clear it.

variables.name: loadError
variables.description: Escaped service rejection message for the current selection; retry forces the selected list to reload.

variables.name: requestToken
variables.description: Monotonic local selection token; service caching and request deduplication remain untouched.

variables.name: requestedStatus
variables.description: Status associated with the latest local request, assigned synchronously before service work to deduplicate initialization, explicit callbacks and status watches, and gate card visibility.

variables.name: updatedAt
variables.description: Successful network timestamp read only from matching public service state, never fabricated on cache access.

variables.name: slicePage
variables.description: Clamps the current page and slices a maximum of 12 entries. Called after recomputation and after the explicit Pagination handler assigns its callback value.

variables.name: applyFilters
variables.description: Computes search/category filtering and deterministic name sorting outside the digest view path. Resets pagination on every filter or accepted load.

variables.name: onLocalFilters
variables.description: Recomputes local derived arrays from explicit category/sort callbacks and supplementary watches. Never requests data or modifies watched selections.

variables.name: statusChanged
variables.description: Verified Dropdown onValueChange(value, event) adapter. Explicitly assigns the two-way status before syncStatus so recomputation does not depend on binding propagation timing. The requestedStatus guard deduplicates callback/watch/init loads.

variables.name: categoryChanged
variables.description: Verified Dropdown onValueChange(value, event) adapter. Assigns the two-way category before local recomputation; no service request.

variables.name: sortChanged
variables.description: Verified Dropdown onValueChange(value, event) adapter. Assigns the two-way sort selection before local recomputation; no service request.

variables.name: pageChanged
variables.description: Verified Pagination onPageChange(currentPage) adapter for all page changes, including first/last. Pagination updates its two-way model before notifying; explicitly assigning the callback value also makes the slice independent of parent-binding propagation timing. No network work.

variables.name: searchChanged
variables.description: Debounced search callback reads the latest model, including resets, rather than a potentially old callback argument.

variables.name: loadPets
variables.description: Loads real normalized data via the confirmed service, handles rejection, ignores stale selections, and keeps promise updates within Angular's $q digest. Clears page-only snapshots before any request; preserves shared service cache.

variables.name: syncStatus
variables.description: Initial load and server reload on status changes, explicitly called by statusChanged as well as supplementary watches. requestedStatus is assigned synchronously in loadPets, so repeated initialization/callback/watch triggers for the same status do not issue duplicate requests. Category resets because its options belong to a different dataset.

variables.name: refresh
variables.description: Force reloads only the selected list and never clears the shared service cache. Also used by pw-feedback's no-argument retry callback.

variables.name: clearFilters
variables.description: Clears search/category/sort, restores available status, resets page, and reloads only if status changes. Safe while a prior status request is pending.

description:
## Pet catalogue
The workspace.pets child route renders at /app/pets inside the persistent workspace shell. Existing pet cards provide detail navigation. Loads normalized public demo records through petData without modifying shared service data or caches.

Dropdown value models are two-way; explicit onValueChange(value, event) handlers assign the associated selection before calling syncStatus or onLocalFilters. Watches remain supplementary rather than the sole update path. syncStatus sets requestedStatus synchronously through loadPets, deduplicating initialization, callback and watch triggers for the same status. Category and sort callbacks only recompute local results; search retains its 250 ms debounce and reads the latest model. Pagination onPageChange(currentPage) explicitly assigns the page before slicing. Stale-response protection, retry behavior and existing presentation are unchanged.
